rules.label: 90 days in any 180-day period
notes: Days in all Schengen countries are added together. Entry and exit days both count.
Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City are counted as Schengen territory in practice.
Cyprus and Ireland are EU members but not Schengen members, so days there do not count. The EU Council is expected to decide on Cyprus joining by December 2026.
Some countries have bilateral visa-waiver agreements with individual Schengen states that can allow longer stays. These are not modelled.
